jei.siliconcraft.info.silicon_ore: Mined deep underground. Smelt or blast in a furnace to extract Silicon Powder, the cornerstone material for all silicon microelectronics.
jei.siliconcraft.info.silicon_powder: Refined from Silicon Ore. Essential semiconductor material used for forging processor chips, GPUs, memory banks, and SoC substrate interconnects.
jei.siliconcraft.info.architecture_write: Created using the Architecture Writer in CPU or GPU mode. CPU writeups feed the Chip Forge; GPU writeups feed the GPU Assembler. Never consumed during fabrication.
Workstation for drafting CPU or GPU architecture writeups. Switch between CPU and GPU mode to select supported instructions or graphics operations.
jei.siliconcraft.info.programmer: Hardware flasher used to burn compiled .sc programs imported via the Project Manager onto ROM chips or Storage Drives.
jei.siliconcraft.info.project_manager: Workstation for managing compiled .sc project files in your world. Import .sc binaries compiled externally with the SiliconCraft N2 Compiler (scc), rename entries, or remove old builds.
jei.siliconcraft.info.gpu_assembler: Hardware assembler that combines a reusable GPU Architecture Writeup, Silicon Powder, Redstone Dust, and 0 to 8 optional RAM Modules using FE energy to build a dedicated Graphics Card (GPU).
jei.siliconcraft.info.gpu: Dedicated graphics processor (VirtualGPU) supporting hardware-accelerated drawing, alpha-blended VRAM textures, and double buffering. Install inside an SoC or PC (max 1 per computer).
jei.siliconcraft.info.code_compiler: Legacy decorative block. As of SiliconCraft 0.2.0, compile N2 programs externally with the standalone SiliconCraft compiler and import the resulting .sc file in the Project Manager.
jei.siliconcraft.info.project_compiler: Legacy decorative block. As of SiliconCraft 0.2.0, compile N2 projects externally with the standalone SiliconCraft compiler and import the resulting .sc file in the Project Manager.
jei.siliconcraft.info.assembly_writer: Legacy decorative block. As of SiliconCraft 0.2.0, assemble .asm/.s programs externally into .sc files with the standalone SiliconCraft compiler and import them in the Project Manager.
jei.siliconcraft.info.computer_case: Chassis for personal computers. Right-click the placed case with any assembled System-on-a-Chip (SoC) to complete computer assembly.
jei.siliconcraft.info.computer: A fully functional personal computer with CRT monitor, real-time terminal streaming, CPU registers, game-tick clock timing, and custom ISA execution.
jei.siliconcraft.info.speaker: A peripheral acoustic transducer. Place adjacent to a Personal Computer to broadcast its audio into the 3D world with spatial sound falloff.
config.jade.plugin_siliconcraft.computer: Displays CPU execution status, cycle counts, RAM/storage capacities, and SoC architecture information.
config.jade.plugin_siliconcraft.machine_: Displays energy (FE), fuel burn ticks, progress bars, and operational state for SiliconCraft machines.
config.jade.plugin_siliconcraft.speaker_: Displays acoustic link status and coordinate binding to adjacent Personal Computers.
